questions.q: What problem does FBDI solve for General Ledger?
options: It allows bulk loading of large volumes of journal data instead of entering lines one at a time
It replaces the need for journal validation
It automatically approves all imported journals
It is only used for currency translation
questions.explain: FBDI is Oracle's standard bulk-load mechanism, used here to bring in large volumes of journal lines at once.

questions.q: What is the correct order of the FBDI journal import flow?
options: Upload to UCM, then download template, then populate rows
Download template, populate rows, generate CSV/zip, upload to UCM, run Import Journals
Run Import Journals, then generate the template
Populate rows directly inside Create Journal
questions.explain: The flow is: download template, populate data, generate CSV/zip, upload to UCM, then run the Import Journals process.

questions.q: What must each row of the GL_INTERFACE template contain, at minimum?
options: Only an account number
Only a control total
Ledger ID, accounting date, currency code, chart-of-accounts segment values, and a debit or credit amount
Only the approver's name
questions.explain: Each row needs the same core information as a manual journal line: ledger, date, currency, account segments, and amount.

questions.q: What journal source is typically assigned to journals created through FBDI import?
options: Manual
Payables
Allocation
Spreadsheet
questions.explain: Journals created through the spreadsheet-based FBDI template are typically sourced as Spreadsheet, distinguishing them from hand-typed Manual entries.

questions.q: Do journals created through FBDI import skip the validation covered earlier in this course?
options: Yes, imported journals bypass validation entirely
No, they still go through the same validation, approval, and posting steps as any other journal
Only validation for currency is skipped
Only validation for period status is skipped
questions.explain: Imported journal batches are still subject to the same validation rules before they can post.
